newsitem.title: INDIA: INDIA'S UNITED FRONT "CORE" PANEL ENDS MEETING. [CORRECTED 14:05 GMT]
newsitem.headline: INDIA'S UNITED FRONT "CORE" PANEL ENDS MEETING. [CORRECTED 14:05 GMT]

text.p: A core group of leaders of India's ruling United Front coalition ended a meeting to consider raising petroleum prices, and a larger committee will take up the issue later on Wednesday (Corrects from Thursday), a spokesman said.

"The standing committee of the UF (United Front) met but it is a prelude to the Steering Committee which is being held from 7 p.m. (1330 GMT)," Information Minister Jaipal Reddy told reporters after the meeting of the standing, or "core", committee.

Janata Dal leader Sharad Yadav told reporters that the standing committee, whose members are included in the larger, decision-making Steering Committee, discussed oil prices and the Public Distribution System (PDS).
"We have discussed oil prices and PDS," Yadav said.
Asked if the standing committee had reached a decision on oil prices, Yadav said: "We hope to reach a consensus."
